sec: Anterior pituitary cell lineages and hormones

items.q: Match the anterior pituitary cell type to its relative percentage — 1) Somatotrophs 2) Corticotrophs 3) Gonadotrophs 4) Thyrotrophs … A) 50% B) 15% C) 10% D) 5%
items.exp: Somatotrophs account for 50%, corticotrophs 15%, lactotrophs 15%, gonadotrophs 10%, and thyrotrophs 5% of anterior pituitary cells. (Book p937)

items.q: The earliest cells to appear during anterior pituitary development in the 6th embryonic week are:
items.exp: Corticotrophs are the earliest cells to appear, emerging by the 6th week of embryonic life. (Book p937)

items.q: The last anterior pituitary cell type to appear during ontogeny (emerging between 12 and 24 weeks) is the ___.
items.exp: Lactotrophs are the last anterior pituitary cells to appear, emerging between 12 and 24 weeks. (Book p937)

items.q: Match the twin hormones to their exact amino acid length — 1) Growth hormone (GH) 2) Prolactin (PRL) … A) 191 amino acids B) 199 amino acids
items.exp: Growth hormone contains 191 amino acids while prolactin contains 199 amino acids. (Book p937)

items.q: Assess the shared characteristics of GH and prolactin: I Both are acidophilic polypeptide hormones signaling via the JAK-STAT pathway. II Both cell lineages are located in the lateral portion of the gland.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Both GH and prolactin are acidophilic polypeptides signaling via the JAK-STAT pathway and reside in the lateral portion of the pituitary, predisposing them to ischemia. (Book p937)

items.q: What proportion of GH-secreting pituitary adenomas also express lactotrophs?
items.exp: GH-secreting adenomas co-express lactotrophs in 20% of cases as somatomammotrophic tumors. (Book p937)

items.q: Why is clinically profound hypothyroidism not typically observed in isolated hypopituitarism?
opts: 20% of thyroid hormone is produced autonomously by the thyroid gland itself
Peripheral deiodinases increase activity ten-fold in TSH absence
Reverse T3 converts spontaneously into bioactive free thyroxine
Parathyroid hormone exerts secondary agonism on follicular TSH receptors
items.exp: Twenty percent of thyroid hormone is produced autonomously by the gland itself independent of TSH. (Book p937)

items.q: An endocrine pathologist examines an anterior pituitary specimen. The corticotroph cells exhibit the largest secretory granules measuring:
items.exp: Corticotroph secretory granules are the largest in the anterior pituitary, measuring 400 to 550 nm. (Book p937)

items.q: Which peptide is NOT a direct cleavage derivative of pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC)?
items.exp: POMC is cleaved into ACTH, MSH, and beta-lipotrophin; oxytocin is a neurohypophyseal nonapeptide. (Book p937)

items.q: Beta-lipotrophin is cleaved to produce endorphins, which function as endogenous analgesics by blocking:
items.exp: Endorphins derived from beta-lipotrophin act as natural painkillers by blocking mu opioid receptors. (Book p937)

items.q: Match the transcription factor to its developmental role — 1) Prop-1 2) Pit-1 3) T-pit 4) GATA-2 … A) Most common cause of congenital hypopituitarism B) Second most common cause of congenital hypopituitarism C) Corticotroph cell development D) Gonadotroph differentiation via SF-1/DAX-1
items.exp: Prop-1 is the most common cause of congenital hypopituitarism, Pit-1 is the 2nd most common, T-pit directs corticotrophs, and GATA-2 directs gonadotrophs via SF-1/DAX-1. (Book p937)

items.q: Under the DOSE happiness hormones mnemonic, which factor is NOT listed as increasing endorphin levels?
items.exp: Endorphins increase with increased heart rate, waking up early, and dark chocolate; prolonged sleep deprivation is not listed. (Book p937)

items.q: The glycoprotein hormones sharing an identical alpha subunit secreted by the anterior pituitary are TSH, FSH, and ___.
items.exp: The glycoprotein alpha hormones are TSH, FSH, and LH; GH, PRL, and POMC are polypeptide hormones. (Book p937)
